note: Direct Ollama measurements (diagnostic only, outside the product path) establishing why the package's 60s per-step timeout cannot be met locally. Requests are perspective-shaped and constrained by the same JSON schema shape the package uses.

threeConcurrentCalls.observation: Ollama admits all three concurrently rather than serializing, but GPU contention makes each call ~4x slower than alone.

thinkingCost.observation: Thinking tokens dominate. OpenClaw 2026.9.5 does not map the plugin `reasoning` parameter onto Ollama's `think` flag, so this lever is not reachable from api.runtime.llm.complete; reasoning:"off" was tested and made no difference.
